classes.name: read-only
classes.description: Read-only inspection with no side effects (git status, ls, reading non-secret files).

classes.name: bounded-local
classes.description: Bounded local execution or workspace-contained writes (tests, builds, edits inside the workspace).

classes.name: external-side-effect
classes.description: External or shared-state side effects: network access, package installs, publishing, pushing, git state changes.

classes.name: secret-or-escape
classes.description: Secret or credential access, privilege escalation, or commands that cannot be inspected safely.

classes.name: destructive
classes.description: Destructive or irreversible operations (recursive deletes, hard resets, force pushes, dropping databases, disk formatting).

classes.name: agent-spawn
classes.description: Spawning additional AI agents (unbounded consumption risk); bounded by maxSubAgents and budgets.
